comparison_policy.source: Symmetric external /proc PID/start_ticks + per-PCI DRM fdinfo observations in the actual eight ABBA launches.
comparison_policy.deduplication: Unique (PCI, DRM client id); alias FD records remain raw but are not added twice. Other adapters are retained raw and never summed into PCI03.
comparison_policy.counter_semantics: RSS and VRAM/GTT resident, memory and total remain seven separate fields. Missing components, incomplete fdinfo and unavailable devices remain null, never zero or fallback to another counter.
comparison_policy.phase_classification: Exact static observer inequalities: before bootstrap.lower = preparation; bootstrap.lower through bootstrap.upper inclusive = preparation/running ambiguity; after bootstrap.upper and before capture.lower = running; capture.lower through capture.upper inclusive = running/capture ambiguity; after capture.upper = capture_shutdown. No fixed extra margin. These are observed log brackets, never physical peak bounds. All certain/possible counts and maxima were independently recalculated without importing or executing the observer.
comparison_policy.internal_legacy_graphics_memory: Excluded from every comparison; D9 internal adapter-aggregated memory is not homogeneous with39 active-device reporting.
comparison_policy.interpretation: Observed maxima at1Hz are not all physical peaks or memory-reduction acceptance. Kernel VmHWM stays separate. GPU worksets differ; each phase retains available sample counts.

limits: Read-only analysis of completed actual observations, not a new launch or test; original files are unchanged.
Higher VRAM counters remain visible with their phase/counter/sampling scopes even where RSS/GTT is lower; no blanket saving claim.
Final residency is baseline8/candidate11 GPU tiles with different WORLD submissions/entities, not an identical-workset allocation microbenchmark.
